study: Dual Momentum Portfolio Contribution / Concentration Audit v1
prohibited: modification of the frozen DM/MRM blend

return_attribution.method: exact engine position and cash replay; security P&L is allocated over prior-close/current-open/current-close intervals and costs and cash interest remain separate
return_attribution.rank: selected rank at the opening rebalance
return_attribution.holding_period: rebalance open through the next rebalance open; the final incomplete period ends at the sample close

ex_ante_risk.covariance: ordinary sample covariance of aligned daily close returns
ex_ante_risk.risk_hhi: squared shares after normalizing absolute variance contributions to sum to one

inference.rank_statistic: Spearman correlation between numeric rank and next-period return

sector_rule: blocked unless a genuine point-in-time sector classification ledger is present
decision_rule: recommend exactly one future weighting concept only for a specific, material, time-stable mechanism supported across independent periods and not driven by one or two securities or events
